summary: Serve semantic sidebar mission rows for each related agent

replay.detail: Reads existing run, step, ask and report-to projections; no new claims.

schema.detail: Adds the client-v0 agent-related-runs read with status, progress, waits, ETA, urgency and folded history.

rules.detail: Scheduling and execution authority are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: The additive endpoint keeps active runs and folds finished runs for 24 hours. Person-held steps replace ETA with waiting-on-you for that authenticated person.

recovery.detail: Reverting removes only the read; additive relationship indexes can remain.
